強暴的男子得資財。

A gracious woman retaineth honour : and strong men retain riches .
A gracious woman obtains honor
but violent men obtain riches.
A woman who is full of grace is honoured
but a woman hating righteousness is a seat of shame: those hating work will undergo loss
but the strong keep their wealth.

The merciful man does good to his own soul
but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
The man who has mercy will be rewarded
but the cruel man is the cause of trouble to himself.

撒义种的，得实在的果效。

Wicked people earn deceitful wages
but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
The sinner gets the payment of deceit; but his reward is certain who puts in the seed of righteousness.
